requests.request: Port only non-duplicative RUN-17 bytes into a fresh worktree created from the exact adjudicated base; rebuild conflicts instead of merging this shadow branch.
Provide a narrow adapter from validated stimulus tapes to the existing replay envelope and virtual-clock contracts; do not replace the replay owner.
Bind declared Foundation scenario identifiers to their accepted generator inputs and preserve owner-computed truth outside this packet.
Translate portable load phases into the accepted bounded capacity model without adding a second queue, overload, or lag authority.
Resolve fault-reference identifiers through the accepted Product Assurance injection owner; RUN-17 supplies schedules, not verdicts.
Run latency, load, soak, restart, rollback, restore, and recovery campaigns on another machine with exact tested-SHA readback; bind thresholds externally and publish measured evidence separately.
Mount the focused replay-shadow suite into canonical test discovery only after scope and denominator owners approve it.
Update canonical state and architecture documentation only if a later accepted port changes project truth; this shadow packet changes neither.
Translate restart, reconnect, connection-loss, and rate-limit observations through the accepted lifecycle, backoff, rate-budget, and throttle owners; RUN-17 supplies tapes, never policy.

Port owner-compatible identified reports into the accepted execution/reconciliation adapter, but retain a report with missing trade ID or price as raw ambiguity rather than fabricating an ObservedFillEvidence record; RUN-17 never resolves ambiguity or recommends an action.

Compose fault-frame recovery observations without changing truth ownership: Product Assurance supplies fault/remediation facts, Foundation supplies containment facts, Intelligence Runtime supplies process lifecycle, and the existing Ledger-backed persistence owner supplies checkpoint/readback facts.
